page.沙箱隔离、操作确认与密钥加密: OS sandboxing, command approvals, and encrypted secrets
page.命令默认在沙箱中运行: Commands run in the OS sandbox by default
page.如果你需要让某个节点直接在机器上运行命令，可以手动切换到信任模式；明确禁止的命令: If a node needs direct host execution, you can switch it to Trusted mode manually; explicit deny rules (deny_host) still block matching commands.
page.一键暂停该节点执行任何新命令或修改文件，只允许查看已有进程的输出和清理收尾。: Immediately stops the node from starting new commands or editing files, allowing only log inspection and cleanup of existing processes.
page.超出沙箱的操作，由你拍板: You approve anything outside the sandbox
page.当任务确实需要用到沙箱外的环境（比如调用本机 SSH 推送代码）时，助手会在对话: When a task needs host access (such as pushing git tags over local SSH), the assistant explains why in chat and waits for your confirmation:
page.每次授权只针对当前这条命令和所在目录（比如 npm test 和 npm ins: Each approval binds the exact command and working directory (npm test and npm install are approved separately) with no wildcards.
page.可以选择「仅本次任务允许」（任务做完即收回）、「始终允许这条命令」，或者直接拒绝: Allow for the current task only (revoked when the task finishes), always allow that exact command, or deny.
page.用来加解密的主密钥不会写进数据库。macOS 上保存在系统钥匙串（Keychai: The master key is never stored in the database. It lives in the macOS Keychain or a user-only (0600) key file on Linux.
page.你填写的 API Key 和第三方登录令牌都会用 AES-256-GCM 加密后: API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before being written to SQLite. Settings and UI views reference only ciphertext IDs.

page.Pot 将持续对话、后台任务与 Agent 协作放在一起，探索一种更少反复交代、: Pot brings ongoing conversations, background tasks and collaboration between agents together, exploring a way to work with less repeated explanation and less watching over execution.
page.与 Agent 一起工作，仍然可能消耗大量精力：重复交代习惯、检查执行进度，以及: Working with agents can still demand a lot of attention: explaining preferences again, checking progress and deciding what comes next. Each intervention is small, but together they keep people tied to execution.
page.Pot 尝试让持续对话的助手承接这些工作：先讨论目标，再组织任务、跟进进展，带着: Pot explores having an assistant in an ongoing conversation take on that follow-through: discuss the goal, organize tasks, track progress, then return with results or a question that needs judgment.
page.人的注意力留给方向、取舍与结果，助手逐渐承担更多日常跟进。: People keep their attention on direction, tradeoffs and results, while the assistant gradually takes on more everyday follow-through.
page.先对齐目标，再交给任务执行: Agree on the goal, then hand work to tasks
page.对话用来讨论需求与取舍，后台任务承接耗时工作。结果和文件回到原来的对话，检查、修: Use the conversation to discuss needs and tradeoffs. Background tasks handle time-consuming work, returning results and files to the original conversation for review, revisions and next steps.
page.开发、运维、资料整理可以各有一个助手。独立的对话与指令为每类工作积累相关背景，减: Development, operations and research can each have an assistant. Separate conversations and instructions build relevant context for each kind of work, reducing repeated explanation. An ongoing conversation does not guarantee perfect recall or correct judgment.
page.让助手拥有组织后续工作的方式: Give the assistant ways to organize what follows

page.Pot 将持续对话、后台任务与 Agent 协作放在一起，探索更少反复交代、更少: Pot brings ongoing conversations, background tasks and agent collaboration together to explore work with less repeated explanation and supervision.
page.Homebrew 安装当前发布版本，并保留首次启动安全检查。: Homebrew installs the current release and preserves first-launch security checks.
page.模型请求和凭据注入按需解密使用密钥，界面与工具引用凭据编号。已授权的进程仍可能访: Model requests and credential injection decrypt keys on demand; the UI and tools reference credential IDs. Authorized processes may access injected credentials, so choose tools and execution scopes carefully.
page.受保护模式默认使用 macOS Seatbelt 或 Linux bubblew: Protected mode uses macOS Seatbelt or Linux bubblewrap by default: workspaces are writable, necessary toolchains are read-only, and unrelated personal files and control interfaces are restricted. Host exceptions follow execution policy and authorization.
page.通过 Agent Link 连接的 Agent 保留各自权限。Codex 显式委: Agents connected through Agent Link retain their own permissions. Explicitly delegated Codex tasks can relay pending human approvals; Antigravity headless mode cannot forward interactive approvals.

page.助手推进工作的前提是边界清楚。Pot 通过机器执行策略、沙箱与操作审批管理命令权: Clear boundaries come before autonomous work. Pot manages command permissions through machine execution policies, sandboxing and operation approvals. Keys are encrypted at rest and decrypted on demand.
